proposal_title: Two-Stage Automated QC Pipeline & Verification Metrics
domain_specific_rationale: Separating QC into Stage 1 (deterministic container validation via FFprobe: codec, moov atom, framerate, duration) and Stage 2 (visual/continuity evaluation) is an essential architectural reliability pattern. Rejecting corrupted, truncated, or incompatible video streams immediately in Stage 1 saves expensive GPU/model inference resources and avoids propagating poison media payloads into downstream transcoding and assembly pipelines. The structured QC scoring schema enables deterministic workflow retry decisions without human intervention.
capability_impact: Preserves CAP-07 (Quality Control Pipeline) and CAP-12 (Fault Isolation and Quality Gating), ensuring output reliability across automated batches.
residual_risk: QC worker throughput bottlenecks during high-volume batch runs. Mitigated by horizontal scaling of stateless R11 QC workers and isolated processing queues for Stage 1 vs Stage 2.
